g.text: SD05 - Fall and Start Recovery (Stage 2; UC06; F01, F09, F10)
All game/control mutations run on the controller loop.
Selected view is JavaFxGameView or CliView; only GUI has voice input.
state denotes the player's current State object at each tick.
ActiveState: check position throughout movement substeps.
Increment epoch and revision before cancellation.
Cancel any owned TimedPressCommand and release its inputs.
Cancel pending results and clear frozen utterance context.
[GUI, or live CLI display interval elapsed]
[GUI, or live CLI display interval elapsed]
[GUI voice was requested before the fall]
GameModel also publishes STATE_CHANGED after this update.
CLI lifecycle events always refresh; ordinary STATE_CHANGED frames are throttled.
Plain CLI suppresses periodic frames. SD02 shows fixed-panel redraw and input handling.
Old decisions cannot match the new epoch. "Again" has no movement to repeat.
Every fall returns to Level.start(); no checkpoints or AI navigation.
